title: PHP2Shell: two unauthenticated PHP core RCEs broadly exploited, first attempt seen 4 days before disclosure; still not in CISA KEV
why: Amazon Threat Intelligence (MadPot) saw exploitation attempts on Oct 17, four days before disclosure, and says php2shell is now broadly exploited; watchTowr honeypots also observed ITW use. watchTowr's FAQ still lists CISA KEV as 'Not listed'. No KEV entry yet.
action: Upgrade to PHP 8.5.12/8.4.27/8.3.36/8.2.35 (or distro backport), restart all workers, and hunt for webshells from Oct 17 onward.

title: PAN-OS GlobalProtect auth bypass: new k0t edge-device campaign exploiting it alongside FortiWeb CVE-2025-64446 (KEV)
why: Already in CISA KEV; Microsoft is onto it.
action: Confirm PAN-OS and FortiWeb are patched and hunt for AdaptixC2 and credential harvesting on edge devices.

title: Node2Shell: Node.js/Brotli decoder out-of-bounds write, public PoC and RCE demonstrated on official Node.js image
why: Imperva Red Team demonstrated code execution against the official Node.js 24.22.0 image via Brotli request/response bodies, and a public GitHub PoC (dimasma0305) reproduces the memory corruption (RCE only in a weakened harness, crash/memory disclosure on stock builds). Not in CISA KEV; no ITW reported.
action: Upgrade to Node.js 22.23.4/24.22.1/26.12.1 and rebuild images; check builds with zlib.constants.BROTLI_DECODER_ERROR_FORMAT_BLOCK_SWITCH (-17 = patched).

title: FortiSIEM unauthenticated gRPC path traversal to RCE: public PoC, still not in CISA KEV
why: Horizon3 published a working unauthenticated RCE PoC on Oct 20. Fortinet says not known exploited and the CVE is not in CISA KEV as of Oct 22.
action: Upgrade FortiSIEM to 7.5.1+/7.6, block tcp/27918 from untrusted networks, and check timestamps of /opt/charting/redishb.sh and phLicenseTool.

title: LiteLLM 1.107.0 supply-chain compromise: credential-stealing release on PyPI and Docker; LiteLLM now suspects GitHub token leaked via AI gateway logs
why: Malicious 1.107.0 release with a credential stealer/backdoor was published Oct 21 and stolen cloud credentials were abused (Wiz). Socket and Datadog have published analyses; no MSRC/KEV signal (supply-chain, no CVE).
action: Find any host/container that installed litellm 1.107.0, pin 1.106.2, and rotate every credential reachable from those environments.

title: ConnectWise Cloud Backup (SkyKick) supply-chain compromise used to reach Microsoft 365 tenants (Storm-0940, ARTEX AI agents)
action: If ConnectWise Cloud Backup/SkyKick was ever consented in your tenant, export Entra sign-in/audit logs now, review service principal sign-ins and hunt for app credential or role changes you did not make.

title: YOOtheme Pro 5 unauthenticated RCE via image handler (CVSS 10), CNA marks it as attacked
why: The CVE record published Oct 22 by the Joomla CNA carries CVSS 4.0 10.0 with exploit maturity E:A (attacked), and a Joomla support firm (db8) says attacks started before the patch. No vendor statement on exploitation, no public PoC, not in CISA KEV.
action: Update every YOOtheme Pro 5 site to 5.0.53+ and look for unexpected PHP files in public media/cache directories and new admin users.

title: 22 newly assigned CVEs for legacy web apps carry Shadowserver-observed exploitation evidence (DedeCMS, FineReport, Weaver E-cology and others)
why: NVD descriptions for 22 CVEs published Oct 22 state that exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation (mostly Oct 2023; Weaver E-cology CVE-2025-71434 in July 2026). None is in CISA KEV.
action: Search your asset inventory for these products, especially Weaver E-cology (fix 10.76) and FineReport/DedeCMS, and patch or retire internet-facing instances.

title: GitLab CE/EE unauthenticated RCE via Onigmo regex integer overflow (CVSS 10), all versions since 7.0
why: GitLab's Oct 21 critical patch release discloses an unauthenticated RCE (CVSS 10.0) with detection rules published; wide coverage (BleepingComputer, THN). Not in CISA KEV, no confirmed ITW or verified public PoC as of Oct 22.
action: Upgrade to 19.5.1/19.4.3/19.3.6/19.2.9/19.1.9/19.0.10/18.11.13 and deploy GitLab's 'Onigmo native worker crash' and 'Org mode render error burst' detections.

title: Unpatched Linux kernel 0-days (ksmbd and SMB Direct RCE, CVSS 9.0) accidentally posted to public LKML by ZDI
why: Trend Micro ZDI reports (ZDI-CAN-33549, -33774, -33367, -34068, -34076, -32005) were sent to the public LKML instead of the private security list (Phoronix, Slashdot, HN, Oct 22). Fixes are not in mainline yet; no CVEs, no KEV entry.
action: Disable or firewall ksmbd/SMB Direct where it is not needed and watch distro kernel advisories for the expedited fixes.

title: Cisco Unified CM / Emergency Responder / Unity Connection hardening release: critical unauthenticated auth-bypass and injection CVEs
why: Cisco disclosed critical issues from an internal security review in cisco-sa-voice-hardening-twgbH9e3, now published in NVD: CVE-2026-76474 (improper authentication, CVSS 9.8 AV:N/PR:N) and CVE-2026-76473 (CWE-74 injection, 9.8). Vendor disclosure only: no PoC or exploitation seen and not in KEV.
action: Inventory Unified CM / Unity Connection / Emergency Responder clusters and apply the fixed releases listed in cisco-sa-voice-hardening-twgbH9e3; until then make sure their management interfaces are not reachable from the internet.

title: Laravel TokenGuard unauthenticated authentication bypass / account takeover on MySQL/MariaDB
why: Vendor advisory published in NVD Oct 21 (CVSS 9.2). Not in CISA KEV; no PoC or exploitation seen. Flagged on vendor disclosure alone.
action: Upgrade laravel/framework to 12.68.0 or 13.29.0 on apps that use the token API guard with MySQL/MariaDB.
